resources.string: Remain on this device until you trash or permanently delete them.
Remain recoverable until permanent deletion. StudyFlow does not silently purge them.
Remain in app-private storage until their owner is deleted.
Remain in the location you selected and are managed outside StudyFlow.
Integrity inspection and restore dry-run never change the database. Replacing a plan creates a private safety snapshot before the first imported row is written.
Password encryption protects exported packages. StudyFlow does not claim cloud sync or protect an already unlocked device from its owner.
